independenceStatement: This reviewer did not author or modify the reviewed production UI, remediation, validation harness, fixtures, semantic collection, or fixed visual collection. The reviewer wrote only the assigned reviewer-report.json and reviewer-report.md and did not touch production UI, tests, collection inputs, prior evidence, frozen design artifacts, specifications, task checkboxes, owner artifacts, Git staging, or commits.

semanticAssertionsSummary.note: These facts are accepted from the digest-owned semantic assertions and were not re-proved from the fixed visual screenshot. The readable-style assertion counts only icons whose computed filter is invert(1) and opacity is at least 0.8.

remediationCheck.remediationCommitSubject: Fix Dark workspace tree icon contrast
remediationCheck.observation: The new fixed visual shows all visible disclosure, directory, and drawing glyphs as readable gray-white marks against the #232329 panel and #403E6A selected row. The prior near-black glyph appearance is absent. The semantic collection independently records 9 of 9 matching readable computed styles using filter invert(1) and opacity at least 0.8.

visualChecks.expected: A 360px Pinned Workspace Sidebar, top Tab strip, SDK-owned editor region, and complete app-owned shell perimeter remain visibly separated.
visualChecks.actual: The fixed visual capture preserves the Pinned composition, the top-layer/Sidebar boundary, and the app-owned perimeter outside the declared SDK editor mask.

visualChecks.expected: Three compact Dark Tabs preserve active/inactive hierarchy, reserved close slots, and one visible non-colour dirty marker.
visualChecks.actual: System Map, Flow, and Research Tabs are visible; Flow carries one visible yellow unsaved marker and the close slots remain stable.

visualChecks.expected: The Architecture header and four compact actions remain on one row without clipping or overflow.
visualChecks.actual: The header and New Drawing, New Folder, Collapse-or-Expand-All, and Refresh icon actions are present, compact, readable, and unclipped.

visualChecks.check: Workspace tree row iconography and Dark readability
visualChecks.expected: Disclosure, directory, and drawing icons are recognizable and visibly use the Dark secondary foreground direction represented by #CED4DA on the #232329 panel or an equally readable selected-state treatment.
visualChecks.actual: All visible Workspace tree disclosure, folder, and drawing glyphs render gray-white with clear separation from the #232329 panel and #403E6A selected row; the prior near-black appearance is no longer present.

visualChecks.expected: The selected drawing remains identifiable without relying on row colour alone.
visualChecks.actual: The selected System Map row includes the digest-owned left indicator and visible marker; the semantic collection records exactly one active-row non-colour indicator.

visualChecks.actual: Both collections record fonts ready and zero remote font requests; each declares only sdk-editor-interior; all deterministic legacy counts are zero and no prohibited legacy shell control is visible.

maskRationale: The single declared selector is accepted only for the visible official Excalidraw SDK editor interior. The review did not exclude the Pinned Sidebar, top Tabs, Sidebar/Back controls, Workspace header, tree rows, row icons, divider, or any app-owned shell perimeter. The remediated glyphs are in the unmasked Workspace tree region.

tolerances.note: Palette/readability, structure, hierarchy, component state, and legacy counts are not raster-tolerant. The auxiliary crop result did not decide the remediation verdict.

findings.screenState: 06 · Workspace · Pinned · Dark / Workspace tree disclosure, directory, and drawing glyphs
findings.expected: Workspace row iconography remains recognizable and readable in Dark mode. The approved baseline shows light disclosure/folder/drawing glyphs; the component contract requires distinct 16x16 icons and the Dark semantic direction uses #CED4DA secondary foreground on #232329 panels.
findings.actual: The remediated fixed visual renders each visible disclosure, folder, and drawing glyph as a readable gray-white mark against both normal and selected Dark rows. The old near-black rendering is absent. No Critical, High, Medium, or Low mismatch remains in the assigned screen.
findings.reproduction: Open the manifest-verified workspace-pinned-dark.png and the remediated fixed visual actual.png separately at native 1280x760. Inspect the unmasked Workspace tree from approximately x=16..76 and y=140..304, covering root and nested disclosure chevrons, directory icons, and drawing icons. Confirm the bound semantic assertion reports 9 of 9 readable styles requiring filter invert(1) and opacity at least 0.8.

unverified: No native macOS package, bundle identifier, native window, physical display scale, native menu, or system dialog was reviewed; those are intentionally outside this intermediate browser checkpoint.
The collection environment does not record the browser engine/version or exact collection-time macOS version.
The SDK editor interior, toolbar, and Library implementation are excluded by the declared SDK mask and are not judged by this review.

Behavior, persistence, keyboard operation, accessible names, focus-visible, contrast, non-colour state, reduced motion, Light/Dark geometry parity, token values, fonts, masks, and legacy counts were accepted from the digest-owned semantic/visual assertions rather than re-proved from pixels.
The other five HF-2 screens are outside this single-screen review.
